forensic_finding: Enrolled participants count in dataset exactly matches 2,461.

metric_name: Primary Outcome Exclusions Due to Missingness
forensic_finding: Observed missing count in standardized primary outcome gsed_Z is 312 (comprising 307 raw outcome non-responses plus 5 observations in singleton 10-day age brackets with undefined group standard deviation). The reported figure of 332 exclusions leaves a 20-participant discrepancy with observed missing values in the derived outcome, which remains unresolved from the released data and replication script.
Observed sample with valid standardized primary outcome gsed_Z is exactly 2149, matching the reported primary analysis sample of 2,149.

Arithmetic calculation using published exclusions yields 2,461 - 332 = 2,129 (discrepancy of 20 with published analysis sample 2,149). In the dataset and replication script, 2,461 enrolled - 312 total outcome exclusions (307 raw non-response + 5 undefined variance) yields exactly 2,149. The source of the published 332 figure remains unresolved.
2154 participants have raw GSED d-score recorded; 307 are missing (12.47% raw outcome non-response).
2148 participants have age-adjusted DAZ score recorded; 313 are missing (12.72%).
